name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited

annual_report.business: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited is India's foremost technology-driven Health Benefits Administrator, operating as the foundational infrastructure of the country's health insurance ecosystem by connecting insurers, employers, healthcare providers, and government agencies.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex investments in specific technologies (R&D for fraud detection engine, claim management software)

guidance_or_targets.statement: We enter FY27 with the strongest platform in our history: undisputed leadership in group health administration, a debt-free balance sheet, marquee long-term investors, and AI-powered platform. With employee costs as our largest expense and a fee-based model with no underwriting risk, we expect operating leverage to reassert itself as integration completes, supporting a return to our normalised margin trajectory.

key_risks: Economic conditions influencing demand and supply
Prevailing price levels in domestic and international markets
Changes in government regulations, tax legislation, and other statutory requirements
Operational synergies yet to reach full potential

latest_guidance.statement: Aim to return to 22-23% EBITDA margin by end of FY27 after Paramount integration
Focus on margin expansion and portfolio expansion for H2FY27 with platform going live in 3 SEA countries
Group retention expected to normalize within 3-4 quarters as churn tail end runs for 2-3 quarters
Capital allocation framework targets returning ~50% of cumulative adjusted free cash flow to shareholders over rolling 5-year periods via dividends and buybacks
No specific revenue guidance provided; aims to grow at par or faster than market from premium share perspective

note: Verdict v3 is a prototype; peer-relative; not investment advice
